scope: Controlled in-memory RPC and packet-store regression. No public RPC, real account keys, provider credits, financial store or transaction broadcast. The old-policy packet is an explicit fixture, not a newly verified live historical day.
positive: Current runtime and deployed configuration still require the current policy and code identity.
The historical packet uses its immutable settled request policy, not today's policy.
Life, saved day and settled request share one finalized block.
A later NFT owner can watch the same earlier saved day; the old request player is preserved.
